name: Gomi Mitai na Otona
source:
I want to die.

As I go on living...

I don't know

how to.

But then again... I suppose I am alive.

Source: https://ahito.com/game/boyslove/big/gomimitaina/
translation:
我想死。

当我继续生活…

我不知道

怎样做。

但话又说回来……我想我还活着。
